# commercetools_checkout_application (Resource)

A commercetools Checkout Application: how Checkout runs for a storefront, the countries and origins it serves, and the payment component it shows. Payment methods are added with a `commercetools_checkout_payment_integration` for each.

See also the [Applications documentation](https://docs.commercetools.com/checkout/applications-api).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "commercetools_checkout_application" "shop" {
  key                           = "shop"
  name                          = "Shop"
  mode                          = "CompleteFlow"
  status                        = "Active"
  countries                     = ["NL", "BE"]
  allowed_origins               = ["https://shop.example.com"]
  logo_url                      = "https://shop.example.com/logo.svg"
  payment_return_url            = "https://shop.example.com/checkout/return"
  active_payment_component_type = "Component"
  allow_discounts               = true

  description = {
    en = "Checkout for the shop"
  }

  agreement {
    name = "terms"
    type = "MandatoryCheckbox"
    text = {
      en = "I agree to the terms and conditions."
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `active_payment_component_type` (String) Payment component Checkout shows: `Component`, `DropIn` or `Express`. Only payment integrations of this component type are offered.
- `countries` (Set of String) Countries the application serves, as ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes such as `NL`.
- `key` (String) User-defined unique identifier of the application.
- `mode` (String) `CompleteFlow` for the whole checkout, or `PaymentOnly` for its payment step. Changing it replaces the application.
- `name` (String) Name of the application.

### Optional

- `agreement` (Block List) An agreement shown to the customer, in the order given. Only for `CompleteFlow`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--agreement))
- `allow_all_origins` (Boolean) Allow every origin to load Checkout. Defaults to `false`; list the storefront's origins in `allowed_origins` instead.
- `allow_discounts` (Boolean) Let customers enter discount codes. Only for `CompleteFlow`.
- `allowed_origins` (Set of String) Origins allowed to load Checkout, such as `https://shop.example.com`.
- `description` (Map of String) Description of the application, by locale.
- `logo_url` (String) URL of the logo shown in Checkout. Required for `CompleteFlow`.
- `payment_return_url` (String) URL the customer returns to after a payment that redirects away.
- `status` (String) `Active` or `Inactive`. Defaults to `Inactive`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the application.
- `version` (Number) Current version of the application.

<a id="nestedblock--agreement"></a>
### Nested Schema for `agreement`

Required:

- `name` (String) Name of the agreement.
- `text` (Map of String) Text of the agreement, by locale.
- `type` (String) `Text`, shown only, or `MandatoryCheckbox`, to be ticked before paying.

Optional:

- `status` (String) `Active` or `Inactive`. Defaults to `Active`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# An application is imported using its key.
terraform import commercetools_checkout_application.shop shop
```
